title: Friends — mid band (~6.0)
notes: Willing speaker with emerging complex sentences; some inaccuracy.

turns.text: How often do you meet your friends?
I try to see my close friends at least twice a month. We usually grab coffee or walk in the park if the weather is nice.
What do you value most in a friendship?
Honesty and support. If I have a problem, I want someone who listens carefully instead of just giving quick advice.
Have friendships changed since you were a teenager?
Yes. When I was younger I had many classmates as friends, but now I focus on a smaller circle because work takes more time.

fc.comment: Coherent expansion with clear topic development.
evidence: We usually grab coffee or walk in the park

gra.comment: Mix of simple and complex clauses with good control.
